name: Landscaping companies
shortDescription: Garden design, build and maintenance companies whose service mix, design credentials, coverage, waste handling and quote process need clear separation.

fiveGates.discover: Can a buyer or crawler connect the provider to the relevant service, audience and area served?
fiveGates.describe: Can the service scope, process and boundaries be explained accurately without filling gaps by assumption?
fiveGates.trust: Can material facts be checked against current first-party and applicable authoritative evidence?

factsAIShouldUnderstand: Landscaping companies may offer different combinations of garden design, hard landscaping and soft landscaping; a provider should state its actual scope rather than rely on the industry category alone.
The primary audiences commonly include landscaping business owners, garden designers, grounds-maintenance teams, but each provider should identify the customers it is equipped and willing to serve.
Responsibility may sit with a owner-manager, or a design director, or a contracts manager, so named roles and contact ownership help a buyer understand who is accountable.
BALI member directory is a relevant public evidence source for landscape professional member discovery where applicable.
Landscape Institute directory can support verification of registered practice and professional discovery.
A useful description separates patios and paving and fencing from adjacent services that may require different expertise, evidence or approval.
The action journey should make it clear how to request a garden consultation, how to submit photographs and measurements, and when a human will review the request.
Public information should address seasonal availability and maintenance options without implying that a generic web answer replaces case-specific professional judgement.
